InputObjectUtils.luau.description: Provides utility functions involving input objects Public entry points include `InputObjectUtils.isMouseUserInputType`, `InputObjectUtils.isMouseButtonInputType`, `InputObjectUtils.isSameInputObject`.

MultipleClicksUtils.luau.description: Utility library for detecting multiple clicks or taps. Not good UX, but good for opening up a debug menus. Public entry points include `MultipleClickUtils.observeDoubleClick`, `MultipleClickUtils.getDoubleClickSignal`, `MultipleClickUtils.observeMultipleClicks`, `MultipleClickUtils.onMultipleClicks`, `MultipleClickUtils.getMultipleClickSignal`.
